Good to know

Body Care for Indian Skin

Why dark patches are so common
Friction, shaving, waxing, tight clothes and sun all trigger extra pigment in brown skin, especially on underarms, knees, elbows and the neck.
Laser on darker skin
Darker skin needs the right laser wavelength and careful settings. We tailor every session to your skin and hair type.
Stretch marks after pregnancy
Newer, pink or purple marks respond best. Starting treatment earlier gives better results.
Sun protection for the body
Sunscreen isn't just for the face. Arms, neck and back tan quickly in Kerala's sun.

Questions

Body Treatment FAQs

What body treatments does Facelit offer?
We offer CM Slim body sculpting, HIFU body tightening, laser hair reduction, MNRF for stretch marks and loose skin, and glutathione IV drips, along with body contouring and weight management programmes.
Are body treatments safe?
Yes, when planned and done by trained professionals. Our body treatments are non-surgical, and we screen everyone for things like pregnancy, implants and medical conditions before starting.
Is laser hair reduction permanent?
Laser gives long-term hair reduction. Most people see 70 to 90% less hair after a full course, and the hair that remains is finer and lighter. A top-up session now and then keeps results.
Is laser hair reduction safe for Indian skin?
Yes, with the right laser and settings. Lasers like the Nd:YAG wavelength are well suited to darker skin, and settings are tailored to your skin and hair type.
Can stretch marks be removed?
Stretch marks can't be fully erased, but treatments like MNRF can make them much smoother, flatter and less noticeable, especially newer marks.
How can I get rid of dark knees, elbows and underarms?
A mix of brightening treatments, gentle exfoliation, less friction and the right skincare helps. For underarms, laser hair reduction also helps by stopping shaving-related darkening.
What's the difference between CM Slim and HIFU?
CM Slim works on muscle and fat to tone and sculpt. HIFU works on the skin's deep layers to tighten loose skin. They're often combined.
Do body treatments have downtime?
Most have none. CM Slim, HIFU, laser hair reduction and glutathione drips let you go straight back to your day. MNRF can cause 1 to 3 days of redness.
How many sessions will I need?
It depends on the treatment: CM Slim usually 4 sessions, laser hair reduction 6 to 8, MNRF 3 to 4 and HIFU 1 to 3. Your doctor will give you a clear plan.
Are body treatments suitable for men?
Yes. Men often choose CM Slim for abs and arms, laser hair reduction for the back and chest, and HIFU for a double chin.
Where can I get body treatments in Kerala?
Facelit offers body treatments at our clinics in Trivandrum (Kowdiar), Karunagappally (Kollam) and Guruvayur (Thrissur). Some technologies are available at selected branches, so contact us to check.
How much do body treatments cost?
It depends on the treatment, the area and number of sessions. Book a consultation for a clear, personalised quote.
